rev6.release_notes:
Sub Call: with Safe retract 6.0, every hole now rapids to the cycle's R plane (Z.1) before the G01 Z0 plunge - after the G43 line and after each hole's X/Y move - instead of feeding down from 6 inches.
Simulate: a Tool Definitions size is used only for the program it was typed for; O00242's (T1 CENTER DRILL) is drawn as a 1/4 center drill, not .010, and its false red holder marks are gone.

cadcam.release_notes:
Sketch: zoomed far out on a busy sketch, the dimensions are laid out in about a quarter of a second instead of up to two; at normal zooms nothing changes.
Drill toolpath: a size picked on the Drill Chart sets the drill to that size; with no drill that size in the library, one is made (e.g. "0.2900 Drill (made)") and picked. Made drills' sizes round like the chart (21/32 = 0.6563).
Simulate G-code: a tool the program doesn't size is drawn as its own words say (a CENTER DRILL as a 1/4 center drill), not at a size typed for another program.
